name: edgespeak
description: EdgeSpeak Agent Skills for Claude Code: private, on-device speech workflows.

plugins.name: edgespeak
plugins.description: On-device transcription, forced alignment, sentence segmentation, karaoke captions, timed-transcript translation, and speaker naming through the local EdgeSpeak CLI. Requires edgespeak-cli on macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64, or Windows x64.

plugins.name: edgespeak-extras
plugins.description: On-device speech synthesis with EdgeSpeak Broadcast, and authorized YouTube media and metadata acquisition with yt-dlp. Companion to the edgespeak plugin.
